findings.quoted_text: Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice. Contractor may not terminate for convenience. Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.

findings.explanation: Ownership of all deliverables transfers to the client upon payment of only the first milestone invoice, rather than upon full payment for all work.
findings.suggested_change: Upon full payment of all applicable fees and milestone amounts, the Client owns all rights in the final Deliverables.

findings.quoted_text: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations are excluded from the overall liability cap and have no separate limit, exposing you to unlimited financial risk for third-party claims.
findings.suggested_change: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, and this cap shall apply to all claims, including indemnification.

findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice. Contractor may not terminate for convenience. Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
findings.explanation: Only the client may terminate the agreement for convenience, and you are not paid for services currently in progress when termination occurs.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed the document and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause stating "Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.", this means ownership transfers upon payment of only the first milestone invoice rather than full payment; please update this so that upon full payment of all applicable fees and milestone amounts, the Client owns all rights in the final Deliverables. - Regarding the clause stating "The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.", your indemnification obligations are currently excluded from the overall liability cap; please revise this so the aggregate liability of either party is capped at USD 35,000 and this cap applies to all claims, including indemnification. - Regarding the clause stating "Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice. Contractor may not terminate for convenience. Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.", only the client may terminate for convenience and work in progress is unpaid; please modify this so either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Best regards,
